item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence of the specific negative scenario this lens asks about: no ally, proxy, client, or domestic faction was reported as being backed by Jokowi for proliferation; no evidence that proliferation was used as a short-term political tool; no sign that he relaxed safeguards to buy loyalty or coercive leverage. So the best-supported reading is that Jokowi’s 2024 behavior was pro-nonproliferation and resistant to proliferation, with one implementation weakness in radioactive transport security but no sign of politically motivated proliferation tolerance.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia discusses nuclear test ban treaty ratification with CTBTO","publisher":"ANTARA News","date":"2024-06-26","url":"https://en.antaranews.com/news/316995/indonesia-discusses-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-ratification-with-ctbto","summary":"Indonesia actively advanced CTBT ratification with the CTBTO, framing it as a response to conflict and uncertainty.
